profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Video @ Flock | C/C++/Rust | System Programming | Audio/Video Streaming
profile.summary: Software Engineer with over 10 years of expertise in system programming and software engineering, specializing in real-time multimedia streaming and network optimization. Proficient in C/C++/Rust, low-level programming, and OS internals, leveraging these skills to enhance system efficiency and user satisfaction through innovative solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Video
positions.description:
• Modernized video streaming infrastructure by migrating RTSP-based workflows to WebRTC, enhancing real-time media delivery.  
• Optimized H.264/H.265 codec pipelines on embedded devices to improve quality and reduce latency and power consumption.  
• Developed MoQ- and FFmpeg-based transcoding infrastructure for drone aviation video pipelines, ensuring efficient media processing.
positions.insights: Skills: Kotlin · Live Video Streaming · Media over Quic · Webrtc · H.264 · H.265 · VOD

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer 2
positions.locationName: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Enhanced audio quality with Opus FEC for real-time streaming, boosting listener satisfaction in lossy networks.
• Developed Linux Webcam PnP features for Citrix Webcam Optimization, integrating webcams seamlessly for improved user experience.
• Implemented telemetry for Citrix Webcam Optimization, refining analytics and feature tracking.
• Modernize legacy codebase through C/C++ best practices implementation, enhancing system maintainability and operational efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed real-time video processing solutions using GStreamer plugins, Windows DMO/MFT filters, and MacOS AVFoundation to enhance webcam streams.
• Integrated H264 codecs into Citrix Webcam Optimization, boosting efficiency and quality.
• Developed component tests for CI/CD pipelines, enhancing software reliability and stability.
• Strengthened security measures in ICE protocol implementation between Microsoft Edge Servers and Citrix Optimized Skype peers for FIPS compliance.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced Gaumard Ultrasound simulation with real-time 3D anatomy rendering using C/C++ frameworks like OpenCV, OpenGL, and Vulkan.
• Improved B-mode imaging accuracy through advanced computer graphics techniques.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to develop innovative solutions for medical simulation technology at Gaumard Scientific.
positions.insights: Skills: C/C++ · Multithreading · OpenGL · Vulkan · CMake · Test Driven Development · GNU Make · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Low Latency · Socket Programming · Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed data transfer solutions using FlatBuffers in C++17, enhancing system efficiency.
• Implemented backend services with Typescript/JavaScript on NodeJS for AWS deployment.
• Applied API design and integration to the airline industry on REST and SOAP endpoints.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · NodeJS · C/C++ · FlatBuffer · MongoDB · GNU Make · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Multithreading · Express.js · CMake · React.js · WebSockets · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Test Driven Development · Nginx · Low Latency · Socket Programming · Node.js · Git

positions.title: Lead Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed custom load balancer service using nginx and Crow microframework on Ubuntu server.
• Implemented hardware security libraries for multiple SoC platforms.
• Designed and prototyped IoT systems based on ESP-32 and ESP-82 devices using C/C++ frameworks.
positions.insights: Skills: Linux Kernel · MongoDB · GNU Make · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · Arduino · Internet of Things (IoT) · Multithreading · OpenSSL · Express.js · CMake · Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) · C/C++ · React.js · Hardware Security · WebSockets · MIPS Assembly · Microcontrollers · FreeRTOS · Test Driven Development · Nginx · Low Latency · Socket Programming · System on a Chip (SoC) · eCos · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Node.js · Embedded Linux · Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) · Git · Linux · Serial Protocols

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
• Conducted research on WPT technologies and WMNs for mobile nodes, focusing on drones.
• Developed an MCU-based embedded system to control WPT circuits using LM75, ACS764, and HC-05.
• Designed and implemented an USB-HID driver for secure data exchange between embedded circuit and Windows OS.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) · Low Latency · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Arduino · Git · Serial Protocols

positions.title: Embedded System Engineer
positions.description:
• Prototyped datalogger systems using Beaglebone Black SBC for CIME in Havana, Cuba.
• Developed software in Python and C/C++ for Beaglebone Black and Raspberry Pi SBCs.
• Designed compensation algorithms in MATLAB for instrumentation and implemented them in Maxim DSSP MAX1464 for real-time sensor compensation.
• Researched Whetstone bridge configurations to enhance analog sensor sensitivity.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Arduino · MATLAB · Microchip PIC · Low Latency · Assembler · System on a Chip (SoC) · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Git · Serial Protocols

projects.title: Webcam Direct
projects.description:
https://github.com/gamilr/webcam-direct-linux

Rust-based application that allows you to use your personal mobile as a webcam for your computer. It is inspired by the Apple Continuity feature but does not require iCloud.

Testing App: https://github.com/gamilr/webcam-direct-app
